capabilities: Create and open .excalidraw drawings from the command palette or ribbon
Edit drawings with the official Excalidraw drawing tools
Autosave drawings with embedded image data so files stay self-contained
Stop autosave and report malformed drawings to avoid silent overwrites
Replace the handwriting face with a local custom font file
disambiguation: Not the full-featured Excalidraw plugin; it deliberately omits Markdown embedding, OCR, AI, collaboration, cloud sync, a drawing library, and export.
extras: Release notes warn users to back up .excalidraw files before upgrading due to an earlier overwrite bug; main.js is kept under 5 MB so Obsidian Sync Standard can sync the plugin; available on mobile since v0.1.9.
intentEvidence: The excellent Obsidian Excalidraw plugin by zsviczian offers extensive integrations and a large feature set
motivation: The author wanted Excalidraw's immediate, focused drawing experience available offline in a vault, without a feature race or extra workflow layer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in drawing tool, and the existing full-featured Excalidraw plugin adds a heavy workflow layer that users who want a plain offline canvas must work around.

relations.evidence: It bundles Excalidraw, React, and their production dependencies under their respective licenses
This plugin has a deliberately different goal: no feature race, no extra workflow layer

summary: Local-first Excalidraw editor that creates and edits portable .excalidraw JSON files directly inside the vault.
